OllieTree Living

Supporting Our Elders

Our Mission

The OllieTree Foundation strives to support Chinese and other Asian immigrant elders to create a foster a more meaningful and inclusive society.  We help socially connect their lives through culturally familiar environments and services. For elders in Charlotte area and beyond, the OllieTree Foundation brings families closer!

Our Vision

The OllieTree Foundation envisions a thriving, inclusive community that bridges generations, reduces isolation, and enhances the well-being of Asian elders abroad. OllieTree is building a “Sweet Home” for our elders. The foundation strives to create that caring and tight-knit community available for all. 

Core Services

Cultural Activity Centers

Tai Chi, Chinese calligraphy, music, traditional holidays

Digital Hub

Mandarin/Cantonese-language app for event registration, social groups, and family connectivity.

Language & Integration Support

ESL classes, translation assistance, civic education.

Health & Wellness

Nutrition workshops, medical consultation, mental health support in Mandarin/Cantonese, wellness check-ins.
